task.title: Fact -finding with the client for the other parent’s SIN

step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to obtain the following information:

ul.li: If the WP has not been deferred and the client meets the conditions to defer the WP, determine whether the client wants it deferred.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 6.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Unable to obtain the other parent’s SIN . Unable to obtain the other parent’s SIN

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention Policy . National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention Policy

Click Save .
If the SIN of the other parent was obtained during fact-finding, go to step 8.
If the SIN of the other parent was not obtained during fact-finding, go to step 7.
